description: Pale tan and ribbed brown, with a blue sheen at the base. Something big and soft-winged shed it in the dark.
lore: Handle one and a little of it comes away on your thumb, and what comes away does not go back. Most of the trade runs on that: an honest seller keeps them in paper, and the paper is the first thing to check, because a clean sheet means it has been touched twice and a floured one means it has been touched a hundred times. The bare ones are not fakes. They are the ones somebody carried in a pocket for a long while and finally sold. [[characters/8c41be1e|Hearn]]'s is bare, and he did not sell it.
gm_notes: The Quiet demonstrated by a physical fact and never named: handling costs the thing handled. Hearn's wing is a door he does not open, and it should stay shut.
